Build your potential | Guessing the meaning of unknown words

When you see a word that you don’t understand in a text, ask these questions.

1 Is it important? I don’t understand this word, but do I understand the text?

2 What are the words before and after it? Can I make a guess?

3 What is the topic of the paragraph?

4 What part of speech is it (eg noun, verb, adjective)?These questions can help you to work out the meaning of the unknown word.
